about.title: A small software workshop with a long memory.
about.intro: Orkitt is an independent software workshop focused on Flutter tooling, reusable UI and practical applications.
paragraphs: We like software that is understandable, useful and easy to maintain. That means fewer mystery abstractions and more code a developer can actually own.
The website intentionally borrows the friendly commercial-software look of the early 2010s. The engineering underneath does not: the site is responsive, accessible and built with current Next.js.
principles: Prefer personality over generic startup polish
